provider_documentation.parameter_4_abstract_verbatim:
Syfte: Beskriver aktuellt och historiskt hydrologiskt tillstånd i Sverige.

Enhet: Grader Celsius

Egenskaper: Daglig uppgift om vattendragstemperaturer i vattendrag i Sverige.

Nätinformation:
- SMHIs stationsnät: Data samlas in och lagras i SMHIs databaser. Data rimlighetskontrolleras vilket innebär att felaktiga data korrigeras och att databortfall kompletteras utifrån expertbedömning där det är möjligt. Fysiska stationer övervakas, inspekteras och underhålls löpande av SMHI.
- Övriga stationer: Stationerna ingår ej i SMHIs stationsnät men data samlas in och lagras i SMHIs databaser genom avtal med en tredje part.

Kvalitetskoder: Grön (G) = Kontrollerade och godkända värden. Gul (Y) = Grovt kontrollerade värden, misstänkta eller aggregerade värden. Orange (O) = Okontrollerade värden
provider_documentation.statistic_quote_verbatim: Daglig uppgift om vattendragstemperaturer i vattendrag i Sverige.
provider_documentation.measurement_statistic_assigned: daily provider statistic, degrees C; SMHI documents 'Daglig uppgift om vattendragstemperaturer i vattendrag i Sverige.' (Enhet: Grader Celsius) for parameter 4 'Vattendragstemperatur' - the daily aggregation operator (mean vs. instantaneous reading) is NOT documented by the provider in the API metadata or the catalog record

artifacts.stations_csv: stations.csv (one row per station appearing in an emitted panel, with provider, coordinates, complete years, n_days, n_dropped_qc, accepted_quality_codes, measurement_statistic, quality_assurance; the seal-facing table read by scripts/245 and scripts/249)
artifacts.stations_all_csv: stations_all.csv (every downloaded station, including zero accepted days)
artifacts.readme: README.md (what was downloaded, the QC legend, why O was admitted, caveats)

caveats: Date column header is 'Datum (svensk sommartid)': timestamps are Swedish summer time (UTC+2), not UTC. Local Swedish time on the same date still maps to that calendar date, so date-only panels are unaffected, but any diurnal or UTC alignment would be wrong. The download portal text separately says file times are UTC (+1/+2 h); the two statements conflict and the header is the file-level one, so it is reported as-is.

'Övriga stationer' (Stationsnät field) = the station is not part of SMHI's own station network; data are collected and stored by SMHI under agreement with a third party. Every parameter-4 station is catalogued this way, so this panel is not SMHI's official network.

Provider metadata documents only 'daily watercourse temperature'; the daily aggregation operator (mean vs. instantaneous reading) is not documented for parameter 4. The panel is therefore assigned the statistic 'daily provider statistic (°C)' and NOT a confirmed daily mean.

No recent data: the catalog flags every parameter-4 station active = false and the archive ends in the early 2000s; the panel is historical and does not overlap the recent-period regime of the frozen model's development panel.
Rows outside the accepted quality-code set for this run's stratum are dropped even when their values look physical; no imputation, no gap filling beyond leaving cells blank.

Assurance stratum of this run: 'provider_published_unqualified'. Values accepted here are labelled at source as uncontrolled/unqualified; the per-station quality_assurance column carries the stratum into the seal so the strata are never pooled silently.
Complete-year counting is done on QC-accepted, deduplicated values only.

v17_roster_overlap.numerator_note: SMHI station ids are provider-native numeric ids; all overlaps are recomputed by scripts/245 as well
